Voat also took the brunt of the attacks that the Powers that Be had to offer - financial blacklisting, DDoSes of unprecedented magnitude, hit pieces galore - Voat was always in the background, its influence and its model touching corners of the internet far and wide. Voat preceded gab, parler, 8kun, phuks, poal, ruqqus, notabug, and so many other platforms dedicated to freedom of speech. For a time, Voat was all we had.
